documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Rolex Rings Limited reported total revenue from operations of Rs. 389 crore in Q2 FY27, up 43.4% YoY, including a one-time tariff refund benefit of around Rs. 18 crore. EBITDA for the quarter rose 72.0% YoY to Rs. 94 crore with margins at 24.2%, while Profit After Tax grew 67.5% YoY to Rs.

guidance.claim: Rolex Rings expects H2 FY27 performance to be stronger than H1 FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect H2 FY27 to be stronger than H1.

guidance.claim: The company expects to generate revenues from the defence and aerospace segment over the next 12 months.
guidance.quote: We have received registrations and initial approvals in defence and aerospace and expect revenues from this segment over the next 12 months.

guidance.claim: Rolex Rings remains confident in its mid-teen revenue growth guidance for FY27.
guidance.quote: Both this thing taken together, we remain confident in the mid-teen revenue growth guidance that we have given for fiscal '27.

guidance.claim: Management conservatively expects EBITDA margin to be between 21% and 22% for FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect -- let me tell you conservatively, we expect that to be in the range of 21% to 22% in this fiscal FY27 conservatively.

guidance.claim: Management expects revenue growth for FY28 to be close to 20%.
guidance.quote: On the revenue part, as I have indicated, mid-teen; we are a bit confident till now for fiscal '27 and maybe more than mid-teen or coming close to the 20% number for fiscal '28.

guidance.claim: The company expects auto component exports to reach between INR 425 crores and INR 450 crores in FY27.
guidance.quote: Not INR500 crores, but I'm a bit confident to cross between INR425 crores to INR450 crores.

guidance.claim: Rolex Rings has provided mid-teen growth guidance for FY27.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, with the labour situation normalized, US re-engaging, and Europe continuing to build on our expanding automotive presence there, we head into the rest of FY27 with confidence with a mid-teen growth guidance and in our ambition to be the most trusted precision forging partner for the world's leading bearing and automotive OEMs

demand_outlook.claim: Automotive components led Q2 FY27 revenue, growing 68% year-on-year to Rs. 177 crore with segment exports up 89%.
demand_outlook.quote: Automotive components led the quarter, growing 68% to Rs. 177 crore, with exports in this segment up 89%.

demand_outlook.claim: US automotive revenues for Rolex Rings more than doubled year-on-year in Q2 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Our US automotive revenues more than doubled year-on-year in Q2.

demand_outlook.claim: Rolex Rings has not lost any customer due to US tariffs.
demand_outlook.quote: Our relationships with US customers have stayed intact, and we have not lost a single customer to tariffs.

demand_outlook.claim: Softness in bearing rings was concentrated in the industrial segment across domestic and European markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The bearing rings softness was concentrated in the industrial business or in the industrial segment, particularly in the domestic and European market, an area where we have flagged our broader industry-wide stagnancy in the past, and it reflects the same labor-driven output constraint that affected quarter too.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in the US market is recovering as customers re-engage following a period of caution.
demand_outlook.quote: The US market is coming back with the customers reengaging after a prolonged period of caution.

demand_outlook.claim: European demand remains strong driven by expanding automotive components presence.
demand_outlook.quote: Europe continues to fire on the back of our expanding automotive components presence there.

demand_outlook.claim: Overseas buyers are resuming order placements as tariff uncertainty subsides.
demand_outlook.quote: Buyers who had been a bit cautious and holding back through in fiscal '26, with a wait-and-watch mode as tariff uncertainty and certain adverse market factors played out, are now placing orders again with confidence.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that Q1 FY27 constraints were due to labour availability rather than underlying demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Our order book stayed healthy through the quarter. The constraint was labour availability, not demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Rolex Rings reported that US tariffs have not affected business operations, which are returning to normalcy.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite the US imposing tariffs, business has not been affected and is coming back to normalcy.

capex_expansion.claim: Rolex Rings will begin supplies to one to two new customer plants in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: One to two new customer plants begin supplies in Q3, new programmes continue to ramp up, and our capacity utilisation of 63-65% gives us ample room to grow.

capex_expansion.claim: An additional 9MW solar plant is scheduled to be set up by Mid-CY2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Additional 9MW solar plant to be setup by Mid - CY2026

capex_expansion.claim: Annual capex is targeted in the range of INR 30 crores to INR 40 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: In the range of INR30 crores to INR40 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is exploring inorganic growth and potential joint ventures with overseas players to establish value-added manufacturing in India.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also looking for inorganic growth or maybe some association or some JV with an overseas player to be based in India, wherein the base of the utilization of Rolex facilities will increase and more value-added processes where the third party has some expertise and a ready market available.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by 220 bps to 55%, EBITDA grew 72% to Rs. 94 crore with a 24.2% margin, and PAT grew 68% to Rs. 74 crore in Q2 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded by 220 bps to 55%, EBITDA grew 72% to Rs. 94 crore with margins at 24.2%, and PAT grew 68% to Rs. 74 crore considering one time receipt.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 FY27 revenue from operations included a one-time refund benefit of around Rs. 18 crore from customs duty paid on US tariffs.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue from operations grew 43% year-on-year to Rs. 389 crore, which includes a one-time receipt of around Rs. 18 crore from the refund of customs duty paid on US tariffs.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA reached INR 69 crores with an EBITDA margin of 22.6%, up 100 basis points YoY.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR69 crores. I'm not considering other income, which is up by 12% on comparing with the Q1 FY26, with the EBITDA margin at a percentage of 22.6%, which is up by 100 basis points, again, on comparing with Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins expanded YoY due to a favorable product mix shift and cost control measures.
margins_costs.quote: Coming to the margin side, as you must have seen, gross margins for the quarter have come up compared to fiscal '26 or on a Q1 FY26, reflecting both a favorable shift in product mix as well as disciplined raw material management and scientific production measures, cost control areas at our plant level.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin for Q1 FY27 improved to 55.6% from 50.7% in Q1 FY26.

orders_capacity.claim: Rolex Rings maintains a monthly average order book between Rs. 120 crores and Rs. 125 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book continues to remain strong, averaging in the range of Rs.120 crores to Rs 125 crores per month.

orders_capacity.claim: Rolex Rings operates at a capacity utilization rate of 63-65%.
orders_capacity.quote: One to two new customer plants begin supplies in Q3, new programmes continue to ramp up, and our capacity utilisation of 63-65% gives us ample room to grow.

orders_capacity.claim: Current plant utilization level stands at 63% to 65%.
orders_capacity.quote: We are at the same 63% to 65% utilization, you can say.

orders_capacity.claim: Management targets utilization levels to reach 70% to 72%.
orders_capacity.quote: We target to touch somewhere about 70%-72%

orders_capacity.claim: Order book through Q1 FY27 was healthy, but execution was hampered by shop floor constraints.
orders_capacity.quote: Though this looks short of our guided growth, our order book through the quarter was healthy, and the constraint we faced was not demand.

orders_capacity.claim: Order book levels remained healthy during Q1 FY27 despite shop-floor conversion delays due to labour shortages.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book stayed healthy through the quarter. The constraint was labour availability, not demand. A shortage of workers on the shop floor meant we couldn't convert that order book into output at the pace we wanted.

capital_allocation.claim: Rolex Rings operates with a debt-free balance sheet and completed a buyback of Rs. 180 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: With a debt-free balance sheet, the Rs. 180 crore buyback completed, and a strong pipeline across Europe, the US and India, we head into H2 FY27 with confidence.

capital_allocation.claim: Rolex Rings concluded an INR 180 crores buyback of 1 crore equity shares during the quarter without promoter participation.
capital_allocation.quote: Would like to inform you that our INR180 crores buyback of 1 crores equity shares concluded during the quarter, with the promoter group choosing not to participate so that the full benefit flowed directly to non-promoter shareholders.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is fully debt-free and clear of legacy CDR obligations.
capital_allocation.quote: As of today, we are fully debt-free and clear of all legacy CDR obligations.

capital_allocation.claim: The company currently holds cash surpluses on its balance sheet.
capital_allocation.quote: Moreover, we are carrying cash surpluses.

capital_allocation.claim: Rolex Rings completed a Rs. 180 crore buyback during the quarter without promoter participation.
capital_allocation.quote: Rs. 180 crore buyback got concluded during the quarter, with the Promoter Group choosing not to participate so that the full benefit flowed to our public shareholders.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has cleared all legacy CDR obligations and is completely debt-free.
capital_allocation.quote: Aso of today, we are fully debt-free and clear of all legacy CDR obligations.

risks_headwinds.claim: Escalation of the West Asia conflict resulted in a nearly three-fold increase in ocean freight, along with higher fuel and consumable costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: We delivered this despite a near three-fold rise in ocean freight ,higher fuel cost and consumable costs following the escalation of the West Asia conflict.

risks_headwinds.claim: A shop floor labor shortage hampered output conversion during Q1 FY27.
risks_headwinds.quote: A shortage of labor on the shop floor meant we could not convert that order book into output at the pace we wanted to.

risks_headwinds.claim: Container and vessel availability remains constrained due to geopolitical issues.
risks_headwinds.quote: But sometimes the availability of containers in a particular vessel is a big issue as of now because we got a remark or comment from the shipping line that they are not getting the vessel back to India because of certain other geopolitical reasons.

management_commitments.quote: We expect H2 FY27 to be stronger than H1.

management_commitments.quote: We have received registrations and initial approvals in defence and aerospace and expect revenues from this segment over the next 12 months.

management_commitments.quote: Additional 9MW solar plant to be setup by Mid - CY2026

management_commitments.quote: Both this thing taken together, we remain confident in the mid-teen revenue growth guidance that we have given for fiscal '27.

management_commitments.quote: We expect -- let me tell you conservatively, we expect that to be in the range of 21% to 22% in this fiscal FY27 conservatively.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets plant capacity utilization to reach 70% to 72%.
management_commitments.quote: We target to touch somewhere about 70%-72%

management_commitments.claim: Management expects annual capex to remain between INR 30 crores and INR 40 crores.
management_commitments.quote: In the range of INR30 crores to INR40 crores.

management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, with the labour situation normalized, US re-engaging, and Europe continuing to build on our expanding automotive presence there, we head into the rest of FY27 with confidence with a mid-teen growth guidance and in our ambition to be the most trusted precision forging partner for the world's leading bearing and automotive OEMs
